flow_operator.semantics: The left value is inserted as the first argument of the call on the right.

profiles.normalization: Exact mapping to canonical Reaper keyword spellings; no stemming, inflection or synonym inference.

semantic_invariants: All supported source profiles normalize to the same canonical AST and semantic IR.
A profile cannot change type rules, evaluation order, runtime limits, errors, permissions or ABI behavior.
make declares an immutable binding; vary declares a mutable binding; change targets an existing mutable binding.
Host effects are explicit and capability-gated; source syntax grants no operating-system privilege.
Source size, token count, nesting, execution, calls, collections and managed resources are bounded by the selected runtime.
Unsupported constructs fail before backend code generation; no silent backend fallback is permitted.
Reserved token catalog entries do not imply grammar or runtime support.

implementation_tracks.scope: Broad compatibility implementation for the current .rpr grammar and runtime semantics.
Selectable VM execution over the reference semantic/IR model; must remain behaviorally aligned with the reference interpreter.
C17 lexer, expression parser, owned AST, checked scalar IR and limited lowering; not a complete Reaper parser.
Bounded scalar source subset lowered to generated C17 and compiled by a host toolchain; not full language parity or a freestanding DuckOS backend.
Separate validation frontend and .qcs surface; not a Reaper syntax profile.

conformance_gates: Grammar and operator precedence are documented and versioned.
Each accepted construct has positive, negative and boundary tests.
Reference interpreter and VM produce the same observable behavior.
Canonical AST and IR fixtures are deterministic and preserve source provenance.
Native backends pass feature-by-feature differential tests before claiming support.
Diagnostics, resource limits, effects, permissions and failure paths are covered.
Documentation, examples, IDE metadata and migration notes are synchronized.
